title: Routing decisions and the information that shaped them
caption: AGRI-BRAIN’s routing over time and the information behind it in four scenarios. From top: the disturbance; the probability of each route after the guard; the share of decisions on which the guard removes a route because of the acceptance criteria from institutional knowledge retrieval, or because of the capacity reports received through the Model Context Protocol (MCP); and the push of the MCP tools on each route’s score. Retrieval removes recovery while the product is still too fresh to qualify; the capacity reports remove routes once the outlets fill or the reports stop. Means over 20 seeds in 1.5-h bins.
